Because Unity Software’s larger historical losses scale-compress the visual detail of other companies, the chart is split into two panels: 1. **Full Scale:** View of all five companies including Unity's turnaround trajectory. 2. **Detailed View:** Focusing on First Advantage, EverCommerce, MSG Sports, and Zuora. *The high-resolution visualization is attached and can be viewed directly below:* *(The chart has been successfully generated and attached to this response as `silver_lake_financials.png`)* --- ### **3. Latest News and Strategic Milestones (2025–2026)** #### 🚀 **First Advantage (FA)** * **Synergy Integration:** Following its massive $2.2B acquisition of primary competitor Sterling Check Corp, First Advantage has spent 2025 and 2026 heavily focused on capturing cost synergies. * **The "Why" Behind 2025's Net Loss:** Although the heavy integration costs, operational consolidation, and debt servicing resulted in a GAAP net loss of $(34.8) million for FY 2025 [[1]](https://last10k.com/sec-filings/fa), analysts remain highly optimistic about its long-term automated screening capabilities and AI-driven background products once transition phases wrap up. #### 🎮 **Unity Software (U)** * **Runtime Fee Reversal:** Unity has successfully worked to rebuild developer relations after the severe industry backlash to its "Runtime Fee" model. The company rolled back the fee and launched **Unity 6**, which has enjoyed high developer adoption. * **Narrowing Losses:** Under stabilized leadership, Unity has focused on its core game-engine monetization and ads business, showing a sharp narrowing of net losses (from over $1B in 2022 to an estimated loss of around $250M for 2025). #### 💼 **EverCommerce (EVCM)** * **Turnaround to Profitability:** In a massive financial milestone, EverCommerce reported its **first-ever positive annual GAAP net income of $18.2 million** for the year ended December 31, 2025 [[3]](https://companiesmarketcap.com/inr/evercommerce/sec-reports-10k/0001853145-26-000010/). * **Strategic Playbook:** This turnaround was accomplished by price optimization, cross-selling across its small-business integrated payments, and cutting back on lower-margin customer acquisition channels. #### 🏀 **Madison Square Garden Sports (MSGS)** * **Record Performance:** MSGS generated **$68.5 million in net income** for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025 [[4]](https://www.sec.gov/ix?doc=/Archives/edgar/data/1636519/000163651925000027/msgs-20250630.htm). * **Playoff & Ticket Tailwinds:** The financial performance was highly bolstered by deep playoff runs by both the NBA's New York Knicks and NHL's New York Rangers, alongside lucrative venue sponsorship contracts and premium ticket sales. #### 🔒 **Zuora (ZUO)** * **Privatization Complete:** In February 2025, Silver Lake and GIC officially completed their $1.7 billion all-cash acquisition of Zuora, taking the subscription management platform private. * **Private R&D Phase:** Transitioning off the public market has allowed Zuora to overhaul its core billing and monetization suite to integrate enterprise-grade generative AI pricing tools away from quarterly public earnings pressure.
